subject: A little boy riding a bicycle along a road
purpose: Friendly animated illustration that loops seamlessly

classification.delivery: standalone animated SVG, CSS keyframes inside the file

style.line_policy: Filled masses for the boy and scenery; stroked tubes only for the bicycle frame, spokes, and road markings
style.lighting: Flat, soft daylight; no shadows except a contact shadow under the wheels

composition.focal_object: Boy on the bicycle, slightly left of center, moving right
required_landmarks: feet on the pedals through the whole stroke
composition.negative_space: Keep the sky above the rider open

parts.crank_and_legs: one pedal turn per 1600 ms; legs solved by two-bone IK at 24 poses
parts.road_markings: scroll at the wheels' rolling speed (period 400 ms)
parts.rider_bob: 1.2 px bob per pedal stroke (800 ms)

acceptance: Reads as a boy on a bicycle at 240 px
Legs stay attached to hip and pedals in every captured frame
